sources.topic: CMOS/SHADOW storage defaults, CRT device, default/locked groups, periodic delay, stack words and uninitialized variables

implementation.groups: Explicit DEFGROUP overrides single-group type inference and RobotContext default; explicit call groups win; linked calls use root group; ordinary position bank calls share this default
implementation.io: CRTDEVICE labels omitted-file READ metadata/observations and WRITE observations without changing callback signatures or opening devices
implementation.metadata: Detached Program.source_settings plus immutable normalized source_directives; storage intent, group locks, stack words and periodic delay remain informational; UNINITVARS retains existing defaults without clearing values

portable_choices.bounds: DEFGROUP 1..32, LOCKGROUP distinct groups 1..32; STACKSIZE 1..32767 words; DELAY 0..86400000 ms
portable_choices.placement: Before declarations, once per directive; CMOSVARS conflicts with SHADOWVARS, LOCKGROUP conflicts with NOLOCKGROUP
portable_choices.defaults: Existing/inferred group or 1; unspecified locks, DRAM, CMOS mapping false, uninitialized true, TPDISPLAY, 8 ms periodic delay intent and 300 stack words
